title: Home Assistant Material: rich editors for every one of the 1577

Main.dc.html.title: Unique integrations get editors made for them

Families.dc.html.title: Ten families cover the 356 with their own actions

Setup.dc.html.title: One setup form, rich for all 1002

When.dc.html.title: Triggers and conditions, made for each integration

n-unique.text: Some integrations are like nothing else: a message with buttons, a robot that cleans rooms, a radio parameter with bits, a bus telegram. Each gets its own editor, drawn at phone size first. The value still decides the control (canvas 36).

n-setup.text: 1002 integrations have a setup form and one shared form draws them all. The field's name and kind choose the control; the data sent back is unchanged.

n-count.text: 1577 integrations: 356 with their own actions, 51 with triggers, 43 with conditions, 1002 with a setup form. The rest bring only standard entities, already covered. A test walks every folder and fails on any field without a proper control.
